Tema: Frutas (Fruits)
Palavra 1: Apple / Maçã / Pronúncia: ˈæp.əl
Exemplo: "I eat an apple every day."

Palavra 2: Banana / Banana / Pronúncia: bəˈnæn.ə
Exemplo: "Monkeys love bananas."

Palavra 3: Orange / Laranja / Pronúncia: ˈɔːr.ɪndʒ
Exemplo: "I drink orange juice every morning."

Palavra 4: Grapes / Uvas / Pronúncia: ɡreɪps

Palavra 5: Strawberry / Morango / Pronúncia: ˈstrɔː.bər.i

Topic: Places in the city

Today we will learn about some important places in the city. The supermarket is where we buy food, drinks, and other daily products. Many people go to the supermarket on weekends to stock up their homes.

The park is an open-air place where people can walk, run, and children can play. Many parks have green areas, benches, and playgrounds.

The library is a quiet space where we can study and borrow books. It is a great place to research and do school assignments.

The restaurant is a place where people go to eat outside their homes. Some restaurants specialize in local cuisine, while others offer international dishes.
